# NKY Foundation Pros

## About
NKY Foundation Pros provides foundation repair for residential and commercial properties in Northern Kentucky (Boone, Kenton, and Campbell counties). Work includes foundation crack repair, piering and leveling, and bowing basement wall repair. Every job starts with a free inspection and a written estimate.

## Services
- Foundation crack repair (epoxy and polyurethane injection)
- Foundation piering and leveling (helical piers and steel push piers)
- Bowing wall repair (wall anchors and carbon fiber straps)
- Free inspections and written estimates

## Service Areas
Florence KY, Covington KY, Fort Thomas KY, Newport KY, Fort Mitchell KY, Erlanger KY, Edgewood KY, Independence KY.
